Youths in Yobe State have commended Governor Mai Mala Buni for appointing Prof. Kagu Abubakar as the state’s Commissioner for Justice and Attorney-General, describing the appointment as a recognition of merit, competence and youth inclusion in governance. The youths made the commendation during an appreciation and courtesy visit to the governor at the Government House, Damaturu. They praised Buni for recognising professionals with proven integrity and track records of service, saying Kagu’s appointment was well-deserved and reflected the governor’s confidence in his ability to contribute to the administration of justice and the development of the state. The youths noted that the appointment would provide qualified citizens, particularly young professionals, with opportunities to contribute to governance and public service. Buni thanked the youths for the visit and their show of appreciation, urging them to remain united, strengthen their bonds of friendship and solidarity, and work collectively in the interest of Yobe State.
